column1: # The consumers the ccomp lane compiles, by label (no names here: scripts/check-boundaries.sh). Columns, tab
# separated: label, pinned commit, the directory of its workspace, its lock file, and a note that leaves the
# consumer out (empty: compiled). setup finds each consumer's checkout by its pinned commit, beside LAND_REPO,
# and writes the machine's table to LAND_CC_DATA. Moving a pin: change the commit here and give the new pin
# its fixes file (fixes/<label>-<commit8>.json, an empty list when it needs none).
